notes: Playing a Character or Stage now lands with weight. The card lifts toward you, hangs long enough to read, then slams down into its slot — and the board reacts: the cards beside it are struck at once and a wave travels outward from the impact, each one catching a rim light in the played card's colour. Play a Stage and your Leader takes the hit instead. A searcher's deck-look now waits for the slam to finish before it opens, instead of appearing on top of it. Two fixes that apply to every play, not just the new effect: a grey panel no longer sits in a slot before its card arrives (the summoning-sick shade was being drawn without its card during the flight), and dragging a Stage now previews where it will land, the same as dragging a Character. Sound: the coin toss now has a coin, and every button in the game — Skip, End Turn, menus, deck builder — gives a click when you press it.
